label_recovery.finding: XML declares <segmented>0</segmented> (PASCAL-VOC field asserting NO segmentation masks exist); authors own calculate_perform.py evaluates detections by box-IoU against manual inspections
label_recovery.conclusion: bounding boxes are the TERMINAL label in the source chain; no polygon or pixel mask exists anywhere

label_noise_measured.method_note: darkness statistic used ONLY to quantify box label noise; never used to generate or reshape any mask

alignment_verification.interpretation: box regions are systematically darker than their surroundings, confirming image/mask geometric alignment; the effect is diluted because ~62% of box pixels are non-oil ocean

leakage.note: sampled check earlier found 8/25; exhaustive full-corpus check found 15/25 -- 6 previously-clean holdout scenes were reclassified

normalization.method: percentile clip from FINAL TRAIN SPLIT ONLY (8 scenes, 219 tiles); excludes val, calm-holdout, Part III, MC20
normalization.nodata_policy: DN==0 nodata excluded (same convention as v0.2)

training_formulation.selected: OPTION B -- segmentation with ignore regions
training_formulation.rationale: 62.3% of box-interior pixels measured NOT plausibly oil, so box-as-positive would inject majority false-positive supervision; box interior is therefore IGNORE (identity unknown), while all pixels outside boxes are reliable annotator-verified negatives
training_formulation.requires_pairing: v0.2 Gold (STRONG_PIXEL Zenodo masks, read-only) must supply positive pixel supervision; v0.3 alone provides negatives + domain exposure only
